name: Extended Bite
body:
Your fangs can travel a surprisingly long distance.

Prerequisite(s): Wyrmtouched, bite attack, character level 5th.

Benefit(s): The reach of your bite attack increases by 5 feet during your turn.

Legendary Races: Wyrmtouched © 2018, Legendary Games; Authors: N. Jolly, Amber Underwood, Siobhan Bjorknas, and Loren Sieg.
